additionalRemarks._instruction: Enter any additional remarks concerning this grid image sequence.

coordinateFramework._instruction: Add the coordinate space in which this grid image sequence exists.

dataLocation._instruction: Add a reference to the file to which this grid image sequence information applies. If the information applies uniformly to a grid image sequence file series, a reference to the corresponding file bundle may be provided instead.

dimension._instruction: Enter the common dimension of the consecutive grid images (frames) in pixels.

name._instruction: Enter a descriptive name of this grid image sequence preferably matching the filename.

numberOfImages._instruction: Enter the total number of grid images in this sequence (at least two).

pixelSize._instruction: Enter the common physical pixel size for the consecutive grid images (frames) (in x,y order).

temporalSamplingFrequency._instruction: Enter the rate at which consecutive grid images (frames) are captured in a sequence, preferably measured in Hertz (Hz).
